title: AI in Education: Reimagining Learning for Every Student
description: AI is used in education for personalised learning, assessment support, classroom tools, admin relief, and the question of what actually helps students learn.
short_description: A clear look at personalised learning, assessment, classroom support, and where education technology helps rather than just generating paperwork.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in Education for teachers, school leaders, edtech teams, and readers tracking classroom change.
